 		mkdir --parents "$HOME/.local/bin"

-	if [ -z "$(command -v vim)" ]; then
-		sudo ln -s /usr/bin/nvim /usr/local/bin/vim

+	# create vim alias
+	echo "alias vim=nvim" | sudo tee -a /etc/profile.d/dev-base-aliases.sh >/dev/null
 
 	# create ssh key
 	if ! [ -f ~/.ssh/id_rsa ]; then
@@ -157,11 +156,11 @@ install_flatpak_packages() {
 	echo installing flatpak packages...
 
 	# setup flatpak repo

-	flatpak install -y flathub org.freeplane.App

+	echo "alias gitkraken=com.axosoft.GitKraken" | sudo tee -a /etc/profile.d/dev-base-aliases.sh >/dev/null
